RPG_RT.ldb and Map0022.lmu come from EasyRPG TestGame-2000, and
Map0015-2003.lmu from TestGame-2003 (https://github.com/EasyRPG/TestGame),
GPL-3.0, by the EasyRPG TestGame authors. They are real RPG Maker 2000/2003
files, used unchanged to check that Yakusu reads and writes them back byte
for byte.
